# Reference Study: [Game / Research Topic]

Use this form for consistent evidence collection supporting developer-authored
CONCEPT and BREAKDOWN. The developer supplies actual reference-game play experience.
Store each game study as `game_ref/[game-slug].md` at the project root; keep its
screenshots, recordings, and supplementary notes in `game_ref/[game-slug]/`.
Supporting research can be a linked topic note in the same library; identify it
as research rather than a play session. Use material you may retain and attribute it.

- Observer, date, session conditions and scope: [actual values; unknown if absent]
- Question relevant to our concept: [what this study helps decide]

Record observations in the observer's words. Reading a review or watching a video
does not establish that the developer played the game. Mark missing experience
explicitly; never synthesize session notes or quotations.
